description_en: Upgrades the minor kernel version of a database proxy
description_zh: 该接口用于升级数据库代理的内核小版本
name: UpgradeDBProxyInstanceKernelVersion

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query instance IDs
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The upgrade time. Valid values:

MaintainTime (Default): The upgrade runs during the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/610402.html.

Immediate: The upgrade runs immediately.

SpecifyTime: The upgrade runs at a specified time
parameters.help_zh:
升级时间，取值：

MaintainTime（默认值）：在https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/610402.html内升级。
Immediate：立即升级。
SpecifyTime：在指定时间升级
parameters.name: upgrade_time

parameters.help_en:
The time at which to perform the upgrade. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC time).

This parameter is required only when UpgradeTime is set to SpecifyTime
parameters.help_zh: 指定时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 如果UpgradeTime取值为SpecifyTime时，该参数必填
parameters.name: switch_time

parameters.help_en: The new minor version of the instance. You can find the new minor version from the TargetMinorVersion parameter in the response of the [DescribeDBProxyTargetVersion](~~API.DescribeDBProxyTargetVersion~~) operation
parameters.name: target_minor_version

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.name: db_proxy_engine_type
